Description

New mums often feel uncertain about choosing their first breast pump, especially when it comes to effectively emptying the breasts. Backed by research and real mom experiences worldwide, we recommend focusing on high-efficiency milk extraction. The

High-Efficiency Extraction

New mums may feel unsure about choosing their first breast pump that effectively empties their breasts. Drawing from research and

Empowering Comfort

Breast pumping can be a challenging experience for moms, which is why Momcozy has
meticulously designed and improved our products to enhance comfort and increase milk
production, ensuring every pumping session is nurturing and effective.

DoubleFit™ Flange

Secure fit

With two layers of flange edges, the DoubleFit™ flange attaches securely to your breast to prevent spills during pumping.

Comfortable fit

Made with soft and skin-friendly silicone, the DoubleFit™ flange attaches snugly to your breasts without causing discomfort.

Increases milk production

Endorsed by Momcozy's user testing research, the DoubleFit™ flange can potentially increase milk production by 28.2%.

102-Degree Angled Tunnel

Enables moms to lean back comfortably during pumping sessions.

Double-Electric & Hands-Free Pump

Empowers moms to multitask and attend to other matters while pumping.

Custom-Fit Inserts for Every Mum

The breast pump includes a 24mm funnel and 17mm, 19mm, and 21mm inserts to ensure a proper fit and maximise milk volume. If these sizes don't work for you, you can try other available sizes or buy additional inserts for a better fit.

To ensure the best fit and comfort, please follow our
measuring guide
to find your flange size.

Hygienic Milk Collection

Preventing milk backflow or leakage ensures cleanliness during pumping, keeping the milk free from
germs and contaminants. This is important for babies, as hygienic milk collection means safe nutrition.

Integrated Milk Collection Cup

Improves sealing performance and prevents milk backflow, ensuring a clean and hygienic milk collection process.

Leak-proof Seal on the Milk Outlet

Minimises leakage or contamination during use.

FAQs

Is V1 Pro a wearable breast pump?

Yes — in the UK sense. Wearable usually means the cups sit in your bra so you can move around. V1 Pro does that with a separate motor unit and in-bra collection cups, on a short tube. It is not an all-in-one, tube-free wearable like M5 Smart or Air 1.

What is a hospital-strength electric breast pump with in-bra cups?

It is an electric breast pump where the motor stays off your chest and the cups go in your bra. Hands-free here means you are not holding the flanges — it is not the same as a tube-free cup. V1 Pro is that format: 15 suction levels and up to −300 mmHg, for UK mums who want a stronger motor at home. We do not call it hospital-grade.

Is V1 Pro a good electric breast pump for home?

Yes. Choose V1 Pro when you want longer sessions at home with the motor off your chest, 15 levels, and cups that still sit in the bra. It is a strong
electric breast pump
if emptying well matters more than having no tubes. If you want everything in the bra and no tubing, start with M5 Smart.

What is the difference between V1 Pro and V2 Pro?

Same type: separate unit, in-bra cups, tubing. V1 Pro has more levels (15) and suction up to −300 mmHg, with a 240 g motor — the home, more-control pick. V2 Pro is the lighter unit: 127 g motor, nine levels, up to −288 mmHg. Pick V1 Pro for finer control; pick V2 Pro if you want the motor easier to carry.

Should I get V1 Pro or an all-in-one like M5 Smart?

If you want the whole pump in your bra with no tubes, choose M5 Smart (or Air 1 / M9). If you would rather keep a stronger motor off your chest and still have in-bra cups, choose V1 Pro. Hands-free is true of both; the split is where the motor sits.

How do I use V1 Pro?

Assemble each cup: flange, collector and valve. Keep the motor dry.

Seat the cups in a pumping bra. Use the inserts so the nipple sits centred in the tunnel.

Clip or pocket the motor and connect the tubes. Choose a rhythm and a suction level that feels comfortable — not the highest.

When you finish, switch off, disconnect the tubes, then pour.

What flange size do I need?

Measure nipple diameter, not bra cup. V1 Pro includes a 24 mm DoubleFit flange and 17/19/21 mm inserts. Pain, a white ring, or too much areola being pulled in means resize before you turn suction up. Fit empties the breast better than chasing a higher number.

How do I clean and sterilise V1 Pro?

Wipe the motor dry only — never soak it or the tubing ends on the motor. Wash the three milk-contact parts per cup (flange, collector, valve) in warm soapy water, then sterilise with steam or a cold-water method. Air-dry fully. Follow current NHS guidance when you store expressed milk.

Quiet, Comfortable and Convenient

I'm very familiar with the momcozy brand and have previously used several models of their breast pumps so I was very keen to try the V1 Pro and see how it compared to others. My first impression was that it felt like a really well made pump and it comes nicely presented in the box.You get two pumps which is ideal as you can use both at the same time. I found the initial setup fairly straightforward although choosing the right flange size is important. The sizing guide included is useful for helping you work out which one you need.I really like the wearable design as the collectors sit inside the bra and don t feel as bulky as I expected. The controls are easy to get to when you want to change the settings but can also be tucked away when you re up and about.There are different modes and suction levels to choose from so you can adjust it to whatever feels most comfortable for you. I was also pleasantly surprised by how quiet it is when running.The clear cups are useful too, as you can actually see how much you ve collected without having to remove them. Overall, I think Momcozy have done a good job with this one. It s well designed, easy enough to set up and the hands free aspect makes it much more convenient to use.

The parts are also reasonably easy to take apart and clean, which is important because this is used multiple times a day & sterilised in our Momcozy steriliser. We ve found that simple design much less frustrating than products with lots of fiddly little components.The compact nature is another big plus. It s much easier to take along when going out or travelling and doesn t require a huge amount of space in a changing bag or drawer.
